captions: A message. A reel. A message again.
On the shelf, a green book. Under the dust.
The last time you opened it? Ramadan.
It waited all year. Without a word.
This morning, the phone stays face down.
You blow off the dust. One page.
You don't understand every word. That's okay.
But your heart knows Who is speaking.

verses.text: “We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.”
